description: JSON-driven admin frontend for backends and AI, built on native json-render. Pages, menus and themes are JSON validated against a component Catalog; a prebuilt CDN script renders them as a full React admin with data, forms, auth and an AI assistant.
rules: Write pages as native json-render Spec JSON: root, elements with type, props and children, and optional state.
Only use component types and actions listed in the Lumi Catalog; check each component's page for its props and events.
Read state with $state and two-way bind inputs with $bindState; load backend data with a Query element and its resultPath.
Save forms with the submitForm action instead of chaining validation, create and close actions; an action array is not a transaction.
Keep JSON serializable: no functions, expressions or component instances.
Validate every page with npx -y @duxweb/lumi-check page.json (add --catalog for a custom Catalog) and fix issues by their JSON path.
For a project without a build step, load @duxweb/lumi-admin dist/base/lumi-admin.js from a CDN with config.json, manifest.json and page JSON files.
